title: Add agy (Antigravity CLI) as a first-class swarm agent type across the sat/ant/sct/bp/qps family + TUI
description:
# useful_tmux_commands: agy swarm-function-family migration

## WHY THIS EXISTS
`add_useful_tmux_commands_to_zshrc.sh` is a ~2600-line STANDALONE tmux multi-agent
swarm library (a lightweight parallel to ntm) built end-to-end around the cc/cod/gmi
agent trichotomy. Google retired the Gemini CLI (`gmi`) on 2026-06-18; the successor is
the Antigravity CLI (`agy`), model-pinned to "Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)". Users of this
library should be able to spawn/target/broadcast-to agy panes the same way they can
cc/cod — today they cannot.

## CURRENT STATE (already done)
Commit 64e34b5 added the launcher alias only:
`alias agy='agy --model "Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)" --dangerously-skip-permissions'`
(next to the legacy `alias gmi='gemini --yolo'`). That is the SHALLOW fix. The swarm
FUNCTION FAMILY is still cc/cod/gmi-only — this epic does the deep part.

## THE INTERLINKED HAZARD (why this needs lockstep care, not piecemeal edits)
The functions form a closed loop keyed on a pane-title convention:
  - spawn (`sat` = spawn-agents-in-named-tmux) and add (`ant` = add-agents-to-named-tmux)
    set pane titles `${project}__gmi_${i}` and launch `gmi` in them.
  - filter/target functions MATCH that title with the regex `__(cc|cod|gmi)`:
    `sct` (send-command-to-named-tmux, `--gmi` flag), `znt` (zoom-pane, `cc|cod|gmi`),
    `bp` (broadcast-prompt, `gmi)` case + the TUI `g|G` key).
  - the TUI menu hard-codes a Gemini row/icon (`NTM_ICON_GEMINI`, "Gemini (gmi) google
    agents only") and `qps` (quick-project-setup) takes a `[gmi]` arg.
If you migrate the spawn pane-title to `__agy_` but leave the `__(cc|cod|gmi)` filter
regex, then sct/znt/bp SILENTLY STOP targeting those panes. All of it must move together.

## PRIORITY NOTE (honest)
This library is largely SUPERSEDED by ntm for most workflows (ntm already supports agy
via `--agy` / abbd51a9). So this is P3 — valuable for users who still use these shell
functions, but not on the critical path. The alias (done) covers the most common daily
use (`agy` to launch); this epic completes the swarm-orchestration helpers.

## DESIGN DECISION TO MAKE (document your choice in the tasks)
Either (a) ADD agy as a NEW agent slot alongside gmi (functions grow a 5th param /
`__agy_` titles / regex `__(cc|cod|agy|gmi)`), keeping gmi as legacy; or (b) REPLACE the
gmi slot with agy (gmi drops out of the swarm helpers; the bare `gmi` alias still
exists for one-off legacy use). Recommendation: (a) additive — keep gmi targetable for
anyone resuming old gmi panes, but default examples/help to agy.

## HOW THIS SERVES THE GOAL
Epic-level goal: every flywheel surface drives/detects agy as seamlessly as gmi. This
library is one such surface; completing it removes the last gmi-only orchestration path
outside ntm.

## UPSTREAM TRACKING
Cross-repo sibling of ACFS bd-47kjh.10.1 (web) and the frankenterm agy-provider epic.
The master migration epic is bd-47kjh in agentic_coding_flywheel_setup/.beads.
File touched throughout: `add_useful_tmux_commands_to_zshrc.sh`.

title: spawn/add (sat, ant): agy-count arg, launch agy, __agy_ pane titles
description:
## Goal
Make `spawn-agents-in-named-tmux` (sat) and `add-agents-to-named-tmux` (ant) able to
spawn agy panes.

## Exact spots (add_useful_tmux_commands_to_zshrc.sh)
- sat: `gmi_count="${4:-0}"` (~line 897), the usage strings "<cc-count> <cod-count>
  [gmi-count]" (~901,902), the validation loop `for n in cc cod gmi` (~908), the total
  `cc_count+cod_count+gmi_count` (~932), the launch loop `for i in 1..gmi_count` that
  sets title `${project}__gmi_${i}` and runs `cd "$dir" && gmi` (~991,994), and the
  "Launching: ... ${gmi_count}x gmi" echo (~975).
- ant: the parallel `[gmi-count]` usage (~1019,1020), launch `cd "$dir" && gmi` (~1075),
  and summary `${gmi_count}x gmi` (~1079).

## What to do
Per the epic's recommended ADDITIVE design: add an agy-count parameter (a 5th positional,
or rework to named) + launch `agy` (the model-pinned alias/function) in agy panes with
title `${project}__agy_${i}`. Keep the gmi path as legacy. Update usage/echo strings.

## CRITICAL
The pane-title token you choose here (`__agy_`) is the contract that T2's filter regex
must match. Pick `__agy_` and record it so sct/znt/bp can target agy panes.

## Acceptance
`sat <session> <cc> <cod> <agy>` (or chosen signature) spawns agy panes titled
`..__agy_N` running the model-pinned agy; `bash -n` clean; gmi path still works.

title: filter/target (sct, znt, bp): recognize __agy_ panes
description:
## Goal
Make the targeting/broadcast/zoom helpers recognize agy panes (matching T1's title scheme).

## Exact spots (add_useful_tmux_commands_to_zshrc.sh)
- `sct` (send-command-to-named-tmux): add a `--agy` flag (alongside `--cc|--cod|--gmi`,
  ~1244,1263,1264,1270) and extend the pane-title match regex `__(cc|cod|gmi)` ->
  `__(cc|cod|agy|gmi)` (~1350).
- `znt` (zoom-pane-in-named-tmux): usage `<pane-index|cc|cod|gmi>` -> add agy (~1537,1538)
  and the selection logic.
- `bp` (broadcast-prompt): usage `<cc|cod|gmi|all>` -> add agy (~1593,1594); the
  `gmi) send-command-to-named-tmux --gmi ...` case (~1605,1606) -> add an `agy)` case;
  the error "must be cc, cod, gmi, or all" (~1612); and the TUI `g|G) broadcast ... gmi`
  key handlers (~2226,2527) -> add an agy key.

## DEPENDS ON T1
The regex/flags here MUST match the `__agy_` pane-title token chosen in T1. Do T1 first
(or at least fix the token), or sct/znt/bp will silently fail to target agy panes.

## Acceptance
`sct --agy`, `znt <session> agy`, `bp <session> agy <prompt>` all correctly select the
`__agy_` panes spawned by T1; gmi targeting still works; `bash -n` clean.

title: TUI menu + qps + help text + icons: surface agy
description:
## Goal
Surface agy in the interactive menu, quick-project-setup, and help/usage text.

## Exact spots (add_useful_tmux_commands_to_zshrc.sh)
- The TUI menu: `NTM_ICON_GEMINI` row "Gemini (gmi) google agents only" (~2055,2363) and
  the menu key that triggers a Gemini broadcast/spawn. Add an Antigravity/agy row+icon.
- `qps` (quick-project-setup): usage `<project> [cc] [cod] [gmi]` / `[gmi=0]`
  (~1629,1630) + the spawn it delegates to.
- The big help/cheatsheet block (~2586-2660): `sat ... [gmi]`, `qps ... [gmi=0]`,
  `ant ... [gmi]`, `bp ... <cc|cod|gmi|all>`, `znt ... <pane|cc|cod|gmi>`,
  `sct ... [--cc|--cod|--gmi]`, "Check if claude, codex, gemini CLIs are installed".

## Considerations
Lowest-risk (display/help text), but should match the signatures chosen in T1/T2.
The dependency-check line "claude, codex, gemini CLIs installed" (~798,810) could add
`agy` to the install hint (`agy` install = `curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash`).

## Acceptance
Menu/help/qps reflect agy as a spawnable type consistent with T1/T2.

title: Verify: source the script, spawn agy panes, confirm filter/zoom/broadcast target them
description:
## Goal
Prove the interlinked loop works for agy end to end (the whole point of the lockstep edit).

## Steps
1. `bash -n add_useful_tmux_commands_to_zshrc.sh` (and `zsh -n`) — syntax clean.
2. Source it in a throwaway shell; `sat e2e_agy 0 0 1` (or chosen signature) to spawn one
   agy pane in a test tmux session; confirm the pane title is `e2e_agy__agy_1` and the
   pane is running the model-pinned `agy`.
3. `bp e2e_agy agy "echo hi"` / `sct --agy e2e_agy "echo hi"` / `znt e2e_agy agy` —
   confirm each targets the agy pane (the title<->regex contract holds).
4. Confirm gmi targeting still works (legacy) if the additive design was chosen.
5. Tear down the test session. Commit (re-diff first) + push main (+ master if the repo
   uses it).

## DEPENDS ON T1, T2, T3.

## Acceptance
A spawned agy pane is correctly targetable by send/zoom/broadcast; no regression to
cc/cod/gmi targeting; pushed.
